notes: Strip x 0-2100 plus overlap to ~2400. Morrison Avenue is the 50-60 ft avenue from Ludlow (x~2360) slanting to x~2270 at y~4170 then due south to Dixmyth; named from the MORRISON label at y~5600 (only AVE. printed further north). Names expanded: McMICKEN AVE. recorded as West McMicken Avenue to match the other plates; WIRHAM PL. = Wirham Place; TERRACE, LOWELL, BATES printed without suffix on this strip (recorded as Terrace/Lowell/Bates Avenue per the plate list). Anderson: printed '40 ANDERSON' with a smudged suffix that looks like PL. - doubtful (Place vs Avenue). The street at y~5000 is printed GAZLEY STREET (not Nazley). Unnamed: (1) 33 ft N-S street printed only 'ST.' at x~2299 from Otelia's east end to Evanswood Place (looks like Otelia turning the corner, but the label is separate); (2) 40 ft street printed only 'S.' from Howell (x~487) SSE to McMicken's west end (603,4798); (3) Cutter's Sub street printed 'AVE.' crossing Vermont at y~5790 (name cut off in the plate-edge stub); (4) a straight private street printed 'PRIVATE' from Ludlow (1780,2197) NE to Evanswood Place (2299,1813) - included but drop if private streets are excluded. Dashed private drives (John Morrison estate 'PRIVATE DRIVE') left out. A 4 ft walk ('4' W.') runs east from Vermont at y~5992 (not a street). Ludlow's SW edge is the plate edge or unmapped county land along much of its length; centreline taken as NE line minus ~66 ft. Dixmyth's south edge west of x~1700 is the plate edge (55 ft width used). The CITY OF CINCINNATI corporation line and the old canal bed are not streets. The white band between Ludlow and Isaac Bate's Second (y 2350-2830) is outside the plate.
